credential: per-attempt machine credential (Authorization: Bearer, X-AQ-Request: 1); the project is taken from the authenticated binding, never from the body. All routes need result.read at project scope (project:self or the attempt's own project:<id>); attempt:self, task:self and task:subtree do not reach results

response.complete: false when any listed report could not be read; the healthy reports are still returned
response.unavailable: [{report_id, reason}] one per unreadable report; reason is outside_coverage, refused, temporarily_unavailable or validation_failed

request.revision: the exact report digest, 64 lowercase hex

response.work: where the revision's work is retained: state pushed_ref (provenance: repository_id, base, head, ref, digest; patch.retrieve lists the fallback steps that read the diff), push_conflict, source_receipts_only or missing (explicit evidence; nothing is recreated or approved). patch.served is false in show: read the bytes with /v1/agent/results/patch. provenance.digest binds revision, repository, base, head and ref, not patch bytes

request.revision: the exact report digest, 64 lowercase hex
request.max_bytes?: integer 1..4194304 raw patch bytes to accept, default 4194304

response.patch: served true: {served, complete: true, format: git_diff_binary_full_index_v1, base, head, size (raw bytes), sha256 (lowercase hex over the raw bytes), provenance_digest (work.provenance.digest), encoding: base64, value (standard padded base64)}. Bytes are returned only after aq-git's answer was checked against the base and head AQ recorded, the size bound, the decoded length and the sha256. served false: {served, reason}: no_retained_work (work.state says why; nothing is recreated or approved), repository_mismatch, binding_unknown, binding_moved (the repository binding is no longer the one the work was retained under), aq_git_not_configured, unsupported (aq-git has no diff.patch capability; retrieve lists the fallback steps), limit_exceeded (limit is the bound that applied), object_unavailable (aq-git no longer holds the base or head), unverified (aq-git's answer broke the contract; no bytes). A transient aq-git failure is 503 overloaded
